anti_bias_rules: All nine candidates remain in the frozen B4 population regardless of certification outcome.
Batch membership and attack order cannot change after certification begins.
A failed candidate remains a failed attempted certification in its frozen batch.
No candidate-specific semantic exception may be introduced solely to obtain a positive result.
Framework/domain implementations outside the explicit observation boundary are not certified.
For candidate 674ea6fd35fa6c39 the authoritative claim concerns one exact source body with two equivalent physical locations; no unique-location claim is made.
attack_order_basis: Pre-certification source provenance and semantic shape only: bounded return semantics first, then bounded effects, then vector-domain logic, then nested vector-domain logic, and finally the largest domain-binding expression.

B4_BATCH1_STRUCTURED_RETURN.rationale: Bounded return-value semantics with no business-state side effects in the accepted projection.

B4_BATCH2_STATE_EFFECT.rationale: Small local state/effect traces with bounded external dependency observations.

B4_BATCH3_VECTOR_LOGIC.rationale: Vector/domain logic using explicit where/not_/and_/or_ semantics but without a nested helper function.

B4_BATCH4_NESTED_VECTOR_LOGIC.rationale: Nested helper functions, comprehensions/aggregations and parameterized vector-domain logic.

B4_BATCH5_LARGE_DOMAIN_BINDING.rationale: Largest residual expression with extensive entity bindings, parameter-tree access, enum bindings, date arithmetic and domain logic.

common_claim_boundary: formal equivalence evidence for the accepted projection and formal mutant refutation within supported semantics
